text:
Isha: big life update 389 just wanted to share two things: i got promoted to Staff PM today and our little one arrived safely last night 476495. low-key celebration at the office? i can bring cookies and baby pics.
Ben: HUGE congrats, Isha!! staff PM is massive. and baby!! double congrats. cookies + pics please.
Noor: ahhh congrats!!! name? weight? send all the pics.
Isha: thanks!! baby name is Mira, 7lbs 3oz, everyone is home and sleepy. thinking an afternoon drop-in next Tue around 3pm for quick hellos.
Cal: sending congrats from my end. i can swing by for a quick hello. need me to bring anything?
Priya: i will bring a small card and do an online sign so remote folks can sign too. also quick poll: cake or cookies?
Isha: cookies are perfect 36a. RSVP (copy/paste):
```
RSVP - Isha baby + promotion drop-in
Date: Tue, Apr 30
Time: 3:00pm - 4:00pm
Location: SF lounge
- Isha (host)
```
Ben: Ben (will bring cookies)
Noor: Noor (card + virtual note)
Cal: Cal (drop by for 3:15ish)
Priya: Priya (coord sign + small banner)
Isha: thank you all. FYI deploy-bot -> building maintenance during that hour means side entrance will be closed; please use main lobby.
deploy-bot: Notice: building maintenance Tue 3:00pm-5:00pm. Use main lobby entrance.
Isha: noted. see you all then and thanks again for the kind wishes! :heart:
